sources.title: ai_parse_document function | Databricks on AWS
sources.snippet: The ai_parse_document () function leverages state-of-the-art Databricks-managed research techniques to parse structured content from unstructured documents. To prepare the output of ai_parse_document for search and retrieval use cases, use ai_prep_search function.

sources.title: ai_parse_document - Databricks on AWS
sources.snippet: ai\\_parse\\_document function in PySpark: Parses a column containing binary data (blob) and returns a VariantType. Throws an exception if the input blob is invalid.
